title_zh: 企业—居民公共决策凭证
purpose_zh: 把公开问题、合成筛查、授权输入、责任人、决定状态、回复凭证和回退动作放进同一条可复核链。
purpose_en: Keep the public question, synthetic screen, authorised input, accountable owner, decision state, response receipt and fallback in one reviewable chain.

allowed_claims_zh: 可以说明问题登记、证据补齐和暂停回退的结构
可以比较未来授权调查所需的证据字段
可以把企业、居民、照护、无障碍、乘客和维护责任放在同一阅读入口
allowed_claims_en: The contract shows how questions, evidence, pause and fallback are recorded
It makes future authorised research fields comparable
It gives residents, enterprises, care, accessibility, passengers and maintenance one review entry

decision_states.meaning_zh: 只登记问题和待补证据，不开放预约或扩容。
decision_states.meaning_en: Record the question and missing evidence; do not open booking or scale-up.

decision_states.meaning_zh: 有权组织公开窗口、同意、最小化和删除规则后，才可收集聚合意见。
decision_states.meaning_en: Collect grouped input only after an authorised organisation sets the public window, consent, minimisation and deletion rules.

decision_states.meaning_zh: 证据完整且没有触发停止条件时，进入下一次人工复核。
decision_states.meaning_en: Move to the next human review when evidence is complete and no stop condition is triggered.

decision_states.meaning_zh: 保留普通公共交通、人工、电话或纸面入口，冻结自动化动作。
decision_states.meaning_en: Keep ordinary public transport, human, phone or paper access and freeze automated action.

decision_states.meaning_zh: 清楚记录撤回原因、公开摘要和后续责任，不把撤回写成失败者的责任。
decision_states.meaning_en: Record the reason, public summary and follow-up owner without shifting the burden to the affected person.

input_channels.access_zh: 可面对面说明、代填和索取纸面回执
input_channels.access_en: In-person explanation, assisted entry and paper receipt

input_channels.access_zh: 不要求安装应用，允许人工转录和复核
input_channels.access_en: No app required; allow human transcription and review

input_channels.access_zh: 在社区、站点和企业服务台留存可取回副本
input_channels.access_en: Keep retrievable copies at community, station and enterprise desks

input_channels.access_zh: 只发布去标识化的问题状态、责任人和回复凭证
input_channels.access_en: Publish only de-identified question status, owner and response receipt

rows.question_short_zh: 上学、就医、买菜和回家是否被换乘打断
rows.question_short_en: Do daily trips break at transfer points
rows.public_question_zh: 普通日常服务是否在站口、路缘或换乘处失去连续性
rows.public_question_en: Do ordinary daily services lose continuity at the station, curb or transfer
rows.synthetic_readout_zh: 合成路网只标出可能的换乘断点和替代链，不代表居民经历
rows.synthetic_readout_en: The synthetic network marks possible transfer breaks and alternatives; it is not resident experience
rows.field_evidence_required_zh: 有日期的分时方式计数、服务点走查、投诉原始登记和授权的聚合意见
rows.field_evidence_required_en: Dated time-binned mode counts, service-point walkthrough, raw complaint register and authorised grouped input
rows.owner_role_zh: 街道服务与交通复核责任人
rows.owner_role_en: subdistrict service and transport review owner
rows.decision_if_ready_zh: 证据完整且公共路线连续时继续复核
rows.decision_if_ready_en: Continue review when evidence is complete and the public route remains continuous
rows.stop_if_zh: 日常路线被截断、没有人工等价入口或回复凭证缺失
rows.stop_if_en: Pause when the daily route is cut, no human equivalent exists or the response receipt is missing
rows.fallback_zh: 普通地铁公交、现场人工台、电话和纸面路线
rows.fallback_en: Ordinary rail and bus, staffed desk, phone and paper route
rows.privacy_boundary_zh: 只收聚合时段和问题类别，不收连续个人轨迹
rows.privacy_boundary_en: Collect grouped time windows and issue types, never continuous personal traces

rows.question_short_zh: 照护链和连续无障碍路线能否保持
rows.question_short_en: Can care trips and accessible continuity hold
rows.public_question_zh: 停车、装卸、换乘和天气中断会不会切断照护或无障碍路线
rows.public_question_en: Do parking, loading, transfer or weather disruptions cut care or accessible routes
rows.synthetic_readout_zh: 合成压力屏只找路线和资源冲突，不代替无障碍走查
rows.synthetic_readout_en: The synthetic pressure screen finds route and resource conflicts; it is not an accessibility walkthrough
rows.field_evidence_required_zh: 连续路线走查、坡道电梯状态、照护者参与、人工接管记录和独立复核
rows.field_evidence_required_en: Continuous-route walkthrough, ramp and lift status, carer participation, human takeover record and independent review
rows.owner_role_zh: 无障碍专业复核与维护责任人
rows.decision_if_ready_zh: 无障碍与照护路线均有等价回退时继续复核
rows.decision_if_ready_en: Continue review only when care and accessible routes have equivalent fallback
rows.stop_if_zh: 任一路线被占用、替代入口不可达或没有独立复核
rows.stop_if_en: Pause when a route is blocked, the alternative is inaccessible or independent review is absent
rows.fallback_zh: 人工引导、普通公共交通和可撤回的临时设施
rows.fallback_en: Human guidance, ordinary public transport and removable temporary facilities
rows.privacy_boundary_zh: 按服务需要分组，不记录诊断、身份或可识别轨迹
rows.privacy_boundary_en: Group by service need; do not record diagnoses, identity or identifiable traces

rows.question_short_zh: 企业时窗会不会把公共空间挤给车辆
rows.question_short_en: Do enterprise windows displace public space
rows.public_question_zh: 到岗、班车、停车和装卸时窗如何与居民和消防通道错开
rows.public_question_en: How should arrival, shuttles, parking and loading windows avoid resident and fire access
rows.synthetic_readout_zh: 合成场景只比较时窗冲突和可回退顺序，不证明班车减车
rows.synthetic_readout_en: Synthetic scenarios compare time-window conflict and fallback order; they do not prove that shuttles reduce cars
rows.field_evidence_required_zh: 企业聚合需求、班次与车辆类别、路权文件、消防净空核验和员工方式计数
rows.field_evidence_required_en: Grouped enterprise demand, schedules and vehicle classes, right-of-way records, fire-clearance check and employee mode counts
rows.owner_role_zh: 企业交通协调与路缘运营责任人
rows.owner_role_en: enterprise mobility coordinator and curb operator
rows.decision_if_ready_zh: 需求、责任、路权和替代方式均可回读时继续复核
rows.decision_if_ready_en: Continue review when demand, responsibility, right of way and alternatives are reviewable
rows.stop_if_zh: 企业优先挤占居民、无障碍或消防通道，或没有保证回家回退
rows.stop_if_en: Pause when enterprise priority displaces resident, accessible or fire access or lacks a guaranteed-home fallback
rows.fallback_zh: 普通公共交通、人工调度、撤销路缘预约和保证回家安排
rows.fallback_en: Ordinary public transport, human dispatch, cancelled curb booking and guaranteed-home arrangement
rows.privacy_boundary_zh: 企业只提交聚合时窗和车辆类别，不上传员工名单或个体轨迹
rows.privacy_boundary_en: Enterprises submit grouped windows and vehicle classes, never employee lists or individual traces

rows.question_short_zh: 谁负责冲突、清场和投诉回复
rows.question_short_en: Who owns conflict, clearing and response
rows.public_question_zh: 路缘状态变化后，谁能在多久内清场、改道并回复问题
rows.public_question_en: When curb conditions change, who can clear, reroute and answer the issue, and by when
rows.synthetic_readout_zh: 合成路缘账本只检查责任和冲突字段是否齐全，不证明有人值守
rows.synthetic_readout_en: The synthetic curb ledger checks responsibility and conflict fields; it does not prove staffing
rows.field_evidence_required_zh: 路缘所有权、维护班表、事件日志、投诉工单、响应时间和升级路径
rows.field_evidence_required_en: Curb ownership, maintenance roster, event log, complaint tickets, response times and escalation route
rows.owner_role_zh: 路缘运营、维护和投诉闭环责任人
rows.owner_role_en: curb operations, maintenance and complaint-closure owner
rows.decision_if_ready_zh: 每个状态都有责任人、时间窗和回复凭证时继续复核
rows.decision_if_ready_en: Continue review when every state has an owner, time window and response receipt
rows.stop_if_zh: 责任人、清场路径或投诉状态缺失
rows.stop_if_en: Pause when the owner, clearing route or complaint status is missing
rows.fallback_zh: 关闭自动预约，改由人工台和普通公共交通处理
rows.fallback_en: Close automated booking and use the staffed desk and ordinary public transport
rows.privacy_boundary_zh: 公开事件摘要和状态，不公开联系方式、车牌或个体轨迹
rows.privacy_boundary_en: Publish aggregate event summaries and status, never contacts, plates or individual traces

rows.question_short_zh: 站口、公交、自行车和步行能否连起来
rows.question_short_en: Can rail, bus, bicycle and walking connect
rows.public_question_zh: 轨道到站后，公交、骑行、步行和人工求助是否仍有连续选择
rows.public_question_en: After rail arrival, do bus, bicycle, walking and human help remain continuous choices
rows.synthetic_readout_zh: 合成网络只检查换乘链和断点，不代表站点客流或可达性绩效
rows.synthetic_readout_en: The synthetic network checks transfer chains and breaks; it is not station demand or accessibility performance
rows.field_evidence_required_zh: 站点分时客流、换乘计数、自行车停放、无障碍走查和公共导视核验
rows.field_evidence_required_en: Time-binned station flows, transfer counts, bicycle parking, accessibility walkthrough and public-wayfinding check
rows.owner_role_zh: 轨道公交接口与公共导视责任人
rows.decision_if_ready_zh: 换乘链、人工求助和消防净空均可回读时继续复核
rows.decision_if_ready_en: Continue review when the transfer chain, human help and fire clearance are reviewable
rows.stop_if_zh: 换乘链断开、人工入口消失或应急路线不连续
rows.stop_if_en: Pause when the transfer chain breaks, human access disappears or the emergency route is discontinuous
rows.fallback_zh: 普通轨道公交和站内人工指引
rows.fallback_en: Ordinary rail and bus plus staffed station guidance
rows.privacy_boundary_zh: 只用分时聚合计数，不保留乘客逐人轨迹
rows.privacy_boundary_en: Use time-binned aggregate counts and retain no passenger-level traces

rows.question_short_zh: 跨边界通勤的成本和回退是否可见
rows.question_short_en: Are external commute costs and fallbacks visible
rows.public_question_zh: 跨边界停车换乘、轨道公交衔接和到岗时窗如何共同复核
rows.public_question_en: How should cross-boundary park-and-ride, rail-bus transfer and arrival windows be reviewed together
rows.synthetic_readout_zh: 合成 OD 只用于比较路径、时段和模式冲突，不代表真实外来流量
rows.synthetic_readout_en: Synthetic OD compares path, time-window and mode conflicts; it is not observed external inflow
rows.field_evidence_required_zh: 脱敏聚合 OD、边界外运营协同、停车换乘计数和跨责任回复凭证
rows.field_evidence_required_en: De-identified grouped OD, external operator coordination, park-and-ride counts and cross-owner response receipt
rows.owner_role_zh: 跨边界交通协调与数据责任人
rows.decision_if_ready_zh: 外部数据来源、责任和地面回退均有记录时继续复核
rows.decision_if_ready_en: Continue review when external data, ownership and ground fallback are recorded
rows.stop_if_zh: 外部数据不可解释、责任跨界无人接管或地面回退不连续
rows.stop_if_en: Pause when external data are unexplained, cross-owner takeover is absent or ground fallback breaks
rows.fallback_zh: 普通轨道公交、公开换乘信息和人工服务台
rows.fallback_en: Ordinary rail and bus, public transfer information and staffed desk
rows.privacy_boundary_zh: 只收跨边界聚合 OD，不收可回溯个人出发地
rows.privacy_boundary_en: Collect grouped cross-boundary OD, never traceable origins of individuals

rows.question_short_zh: 晚归时段是否仍有安全和人工选择
rows.question_short_en: Do safe human choices remain at night
rows.public_question_zh: 夜班、晚归、照护和末班换乘的风险由谁看见并接管
rows.public_question_en: Who sees and takes over risks for night work, late return, care and last transfers
rows.synthetic_readout_zh: 合成时段屏只提示末班和回退冲突，不证明夜间安全
rows.synthetic_readout_en: The synthetic time-window screen flags last-service and fallback conflicts; it is not night safety evidence
rows.field_evidence_required_zh: 夜间分时走查、末班信息、照明和求助点核验、事件和投诉台账
rows.field_evidence_required_en: Night-time walkthrough, last-service information, lighting and help-point check, incident and complaint register
rows.owner_role_zh: 夜间服务与安全复核责任人
rows.owner_role_en: night service and safety review owner
rows.decision_if_ready_zh: 末班、人工求助、照明和安全责任均有回读时继续复核
rows.decision_if_ready_en: Continue review when last service, human help, lighting and safety ownership are reviewable
rows.stop_if_zh: 末班后没有公共或人工等价路线，或安全事件没有升级路径
rows.stop_if_en: Pause when no public or human-equivalent route remains after last service or incidents lack escalation
rows.fallback_zh: 普通公共交通、现场人工台、电话求助和撤回自动服务
rows.fallback_en: Ordinary public transport, staffed desk, phone help and withdrawn automated service
rows.privacy_boundary_zh: 只登记事件类别和时段，不建立夜间个人轨迹
rows.privacy_boundary_en: Record incident types and time windows, never build night-time personal traces

rows.question_short_zh: 装卸、消防和维护能否不互相堵住
rows.question_short_en: Can loading, fire access and maintenance coexist
rows.public_question_zh: 物流装卸、消防净空、维护车辆和居民通行如何共用时段路缘
rows.public_question_en: How can loading, fire clearance, maintenance vehicles and resident passage share a time-windowed curb
rows.synthetic_readout_zh: 合成路缘压力只暴露冲突组合和撤回顺序，不证明现场可用
rows.synthetic_readout_en: Synthetic curb pressure exposes conflict combinations and withdrawal order; it is not field availability
rows.field_evidence_required_zh: 车辆类别、装卸时窗、消防与应急核验、维护班表和事件回放
rows.field_evidence_required_en: Vehicle classes, loading windows, fire and emergency check, maintenance roster and event replay
rows.owner_role_zh: 物流、消防接口和维护复核责任人
rows.owner_role_en: freight, fire-interface and maintenance review owner
rows.decision_if_ready_zh: 应急优先、责任和清场动作均可回读时继续复核
rows.decision_if_ready_en: Continue review when emergency priority, ownership and clearing actions are reviewable
rows.stop_if_zh: 消防净空、居民通行或维护回退任一项不能保证
rows.stop_if_en: Pause when fire clearance, resident passage or maintenance fallback cannot be guaranteed
rows.fallback_zh: 关闭试验时窗，改用普通公共路线和人工现场调度
rows.fallback_en: Close the experimental window and use ordinary public routes and human field dispatch
rows.privacy_boundary_zh: 记录车辆类别和事件，不公开车牌、联系人或个人轨迹
rows.privacy_boundary_en: Record vehicle classes and events, never publish plates, contacts or personal traces
